title: Normalized ordinary integral immersion comparison data
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, with integer ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For an immersion $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], use modules over the completed coefficient sheaves $B_X,B_Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and their finite scalar-reduction module categories [def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction], their integral constructible subcategories $\mathcal C_X,\mathcal C_Y$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], the specified integral pullback $f_R^*$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], completed module direct image $P_f$ and its total right derived functor $RP_f$ [def-weil-derived-direct-image], and the scalar-extension/restriction adjunction $r_n\dashv s_n$ for every $n\ge1$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Define ordinary module inverse image $Q_f$ as the specified left adjoint of $P_f$, its ordinary adjunction $Q_f\dashv P_f$, the exact termwise derived inverse image $DQ_f$, and the induced unbounded adjunction $DQ_f\dashv RP_f$. Define the ordinary finite-reduction arrow $r_nRP_fK\to Rf_{*,n}r_nK$ as the scalar-adjunction transpose of $RP_fK\to RP_fs_nr_nK\cong s_nRf_{*,n}r_nK$, using the actual reduction unit and scalar-restriction/direct-image comparison.

Define a normalized ordinary integral comparison datum for $f$ to consist of the following data and equations. It has a completed direct-image model datum [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models], whose structure map is the canonical completed coefficient map, with an isomorphism of its completed image to $RP_f$ respecting the actual cochain right-derived unit [def-derived-cochain-right-unit]. It has a natural map $v:DQ_f\to f_R^*$ invertible on derived-complete objects, with $DQ_f$ preserving completeness. On each good K-flat representative [def-a1-flat-term-kflat-complex] [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], $v$ is represented by a map to the strict pullback Roos complex [def-pur-integral-operation-complex-models] of the strict finite pullback tower [def-a1-integral-finite-pullback-tower] with levelwise finite module pullbacks [def-pur-integral-finite-pullback], formed with the tower transition endomorphism [def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism], whose projection at every positive quotient is the scalar-adjunction unit followed by the finite pullback unit and the scalar-restriction/direct-image comparison, and whose second Roos coordinate is zero.

For each $K\in\mathcal C_X$ and each specified strict quotient-tower direct-image presentation $L$ [def-weil-derived-direct-image] [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], it has an isomorphism $RP_fK\cong L$. Its projection at every $n$ is $RP_f$ applied to the actual reduction unit followed by the scalar-restriction/direct-image comparison. The specified reduction comparison of $L$ is invertible, and composing its map with the reduction of this isomorphism is the ordinary finite-reduction arrow defined above. The datum further records $RP_f(\mathcal C_X)\subset\mathcal C_Y$; $DQ_f(\mathcal C_Y)$ and $f_R^*(\mathcal C_Y)$ lie in $\mathcal C_X$; the specified integral pullback finite comparison on every good representative is invertible; and, whenever $a\le b$ bounds all positive reductions of $K\in\mathcal C_Y$, the same $[a,b]$ contains the cohomological support [def-weil-cohomological-support] of all positive reductions of $DQ_fK$. This defines a type of data and does not assert its inhabitance.
